biocs.name: Uncommon Remote Service Start via sc.exe
biocs.description: Detection of sc.exe being used to start a remote service on a non-standard endpoint
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
